notes.title: Update #6 Hot Fix
notes.notes:
[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Leaderboard should now show the scores correctly
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game to use multiple weekly leaderboards
[*] Fixed a bug where player would not be able to close the book in the tutorial when using a controller
[*] Fixed a bug where some buttons did not  deactivate when “hide controls” toggle was active
[*] Fixed a visual bug that caused “(click for more info)” text to render incorrectly
[*] You will now be able to get Weekly Champion achievement upon opening a leaderboard and not only at the end of weekly run
[/list]

notes.title: Dungeon Divers Update #6: TB Carnival, Spanish Localization, and New Features!
notes.notes:
Hey all,

If you see any bugs please report them in the forum or on the discord as that helps us immensely! We have brand new rooms, features, a few fixes and Spanish localization.

Please leave a review, these help with visibility! 

Here's what we got. 

[h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Spanish translation is now available
[*]New Weekly Runs and global leaderboards
[*]New items: Broken Wand & Gumboots
[*]New Rooms:Boulder Room & Mirror Room
[*]Puzzle mode: less random, all rooms present, smaller levels
[*]Changes to Normal and Hard campaigns
[*]Controller Support
[*]Setting to remove input buttons/text in game.
[/list]

[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Fixed 2 bugs that caused abyss to fail generating
[*]Smaller bugfixes and translation fixes
[/list]

Thanks again for all your wonderful feedback and suggestions, please keep them coming and until next time. 

Happy diving!

notes.title: Dungeon Divers Update #2
notes.notes:
Hey all,

We're absolutely thrilled at all the fun everyone is having and we're hard at work getting those bugs squashed and implementing some of the changes you're requesting. 

Please leave a review as that really helps us out! 

Here's what we got. 

[h3][b]Additions[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*]Great improvements for predictable level generation (and improved bad cases in normal generation)

[*]Predictable level generation toggle and Stop timers toggle no longer disables the achievements in turned on

[*]Added completion time for Game Over and Victory screens

[*]Added a Win Streak Counter in Progression tab

[*]New types of room layouts

[*]You can now move the camera when showing the level in game over screen

[/list]
[h3][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Fixes for level generation:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where generation was breaking if a barricade room tried to spawn near a single wall
[*]Fixed a bug where a special room would spawn on top of entrance
[*]Improved stability for generation
[*]Improved generation for predictable mode (now even more predictable and stable)
[/list]
[*][b]Fixes for Abyss:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a bug where error room would incorrectly spawn in abyss level in confusion challenge
[*]Fixed a bug where last level on Abyss would “jump” after every action
[*]Fixed a bug where Abyss would incorrectly restore player marks upon returning to the level
[*]Fixed a bug where player would need to take damage to progress the level if he instantly completed it
[*]Passive items should now correctly work in Abyss
[/list]

[/list]
Thanks again for all your wonderful feedback and suggestions, please keep them coming and until next time. 

Happy diving!

notes.title: Dungeon Divers is a dungeon-themed take on Minesweeper that gets complicated
notes.notes:
What do you get when you cross Minesweeper with a sort-of dungeon crawler? Well Dungeon Divers is pretty much the answer to that.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2024/08/dungeon-divers-is-a-dungeon-themed-take-on-minesweeper-that-gets-complicated

notes.title: Demo Update #4
notes.notes:
Hey all,

Here's the patch notes for Demo Update #4, if you have any issues please make sure to post in the forums so we can address them quickly. Thanks for all your wonderful feedback thus far. Please wishlist as that helps out immensely! 

[h3]Main Changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] You will now get a short description of its rules for the room when you hover over its icon in the top right
[*] Items now are being pooled contextually (for example you can't get charge items without active items)
[*] Added key remapping for keyboard/mouse
[*] Add try tutorial popup for new players upon starting new game
[/list]

[h3]Shop:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Prices in later shops were increased slightly
[*] Fix shop price color for items on sale (it's now golden and has a little “sale” text)
[/list]

[h3]Item changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Buff to Piggy Bank (now gives 2-3 coins per damage taken)
[*] Nerf to bandages (now only gives armor if you don't have any armor)
[/list]

[h3]Other Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixes for black market and outsider rooms (made them more consistent to find) 
[*] Fixed some errors in tutorial dialog
[*] Added additional explanation for distance in black market and outsider rooms pages
[*] Changed normal campaign (black market rooms removed from normal)
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where upon reloading a save shop prices for later shops would reset
[*] Fixed a bug where ultra-wide resolutions would break the camera
[*] Fixed a bug where game mode text above continue button would not show correctly 
[/list]

Till next time, happy diving!
